newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire up 8.93 pct on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Empire up 8.93 pct on technical buying.

text.p: Empire East Land Holdings Inc rose 8.93 percent to 3.05 pesos in late Manila trade on Tuesday due to technical buying, traders said.
"The issue is undervalued. It's dirt cheap at 3.05 pesos compared to its book value of above four pesos," said Henry Ong at Sapphire Securities.
Other traders said they expected Empire East shares to recover after it had been battered in recent weeks.
"There's no way but up for the issue," said one local broker, adding Empire East is fundamentally sound.
"It has suffered so much already due to negative perception in the Philippine property business," the broker added.
Some 30.87 million shares of Empire East changed hands as of 11:38 a.m. local time.
